lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 high-contrast vertical lines; spacing is roughly 1.5x wider in the mid-torso region compared to the posterior spacing.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Y-shaped topological split observed at the dorsal origin of the third vertical line from the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Line 10 and 11 from the posterior terminate prior to the ventral line; line 9 shows a segment break in the mid-flank region.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Low density; 4-5 distinct circular white spots located on the lower haunch above the hock.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots form a semi-horizontal alignment across the lower third of the thigh.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast white chevron-style marking visible on the lower neck/chest region.
